text:
marta: Giving handoff for late shift — quick summary of known flaky signals before I log off. Please pick up escalation if anything crosses threshold.

sam: thanks! quick list?

marta: 1) KV prefetch alert churn in eu-west-1 — noisy on short tails. I've muted the alert for 10m at the aggregation layer, created follow-up to tune the query. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/kv-prefetch

devon: is this the same spike we saw last week? any correlation with batch window?

marta: similar pattern but lower severity. appears when encoder-pool-2 drains and we regen connections. No user impact yet. Signal: `kv.prefetch.latency_p50` fluctuates. I've added a dashboard panel under eng/runtime -> Prefetch -> Recent.

lee: will watch encoder-pool-2. I left a small drain-safety patch landed on main (PR #4321) that should reduce connection churn — not rolled to prod except canary yet.

raj: pinged infra to raise encoder pool replica count on canary if we observe >15% retry rate. who owns the canary rollout?

marta: I'm handing canary to lee for the night. If you see >1% 5xx on canary route route/model=redwood-base, rollback policy is immediate.

oncall-bot: Incident playbook reminder: if latency > 500ms sustained for 5m across >=3 pods, escalate to #eng-oncall-pager.

sam: noted — i'll keep an eye on the token cost/throughput graphs too. any CRs you want us to finish while oncall?

marta: small asks: (a) please review PR #4340 (alert query tweak) — it's blocking the follow-up, (b) re-verify `kv-prefetch` mute didn't mask a legit spike (query I used below), (c) if you hit noisy rate again, add a brief snippet to the handoff thread.

marta: copy of the query I ran:
```
select count(*) from metrics
where name = 'kv.prefetch.calls'
and region = 'eu-west-1'
and ts > now() - interval '15 minutes'
group by pod
```

devon: will review PR #4340 tonight. If we need a temporary suppression rule, prefer 1-2m window with owner tag.

lee: i've enabled a canary bump to 3 replicas for encoder-pool-2 in eu-west-1; monitoring now. If anything odd, i'll rollback to 1.

raj: FYI, alert quieting last night was manual; added note in the alert definition: "muted-by:marta" so it's auditable.

sam: if anyone wants to take long-term follow-up, suggest an eval to reproduce connection regen pattern under load with new prefetch logic. I can schedule a short test tomorrow.

marta: thanks — appreciate it. Leaving my phone on for 30m if anyone needs me. Good handoff to lee.

lee: got it. i'll update this thread with any changes. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded for 6h shift — owner: lee, secondary: sam.

lee: quick FYI — I'll ping infra if retries cross 10% and open a case for a kube drain precheck.

sam: copying this into the morning async notes too. good handoff, thanks team. :coffee:
